collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager has been promised a harmless prank sometime this month and is waiting: ask for a hint, or stop worrying about it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) asks (friend), very politely, whether (subject.he/she) may play one small, harmless prank on (friend.him/her) at some point in the next month. (friend), flattered to be asked, says yes. This turns out to be a mistake. Ever since, (friend) has checked every basket before reaching into it, sniffed every cup and opened every door very slowly. Nothing has happened. It is driving (friend.him/her) gently mad.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) smiles and says, "It might already have happened." (friend) spends the whole evening searching (friend.his/her) hut. Nothing has changed. Or has it? Was the water jar always on that side? At the end of the month (subject) reveals the prank: there never was a prank. There was only the waiting. (friend) admits that this was very good, and immediately asks permission to play one of (friend.his/her) own.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (friend) decides not to think about it any more. The month nearly ends. On the very last morning, (friend.he/she) slips on (friend.his/her) sandals and finds a small flower tucked into each one. That's it. That's the whole prank. (friend) wears the flowers all day, a little disappointed and very touched.
